sentences.text: Protocaiman belongs to the family Alligatoridae, a group of crocodilians.
The genus Protocaiman was first described in 2018, with the type species Protocaiman peligrensis found in the Salamanca Formation of Argentina.
The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — is the partial skull MLP 80-X-10-1.
Protocaiman peligrensis lived in Patagonia during the Paleocene epoch. The genus existed from the Maastrichtian to the Danian, between 72.2 and 61.66 million years ago.
